Good afternoon, Chidi. Thanks for following up on invoice INV-88.

I checked with Access Bank, and the transfer of ₦250,000 actually went through and was credited to your account — despite what our system showed as failed. The bank confirmed it was deposited on 21 Nov 2026 (session ID 000014261121140211000088).

Could you check your Access Bank account (0234567891) to confirm you've received it? If for some reason it isn't showing up, let me know and we'll look further — but we'd avoid sending a second payment until we've confirmed, so you don't end up doubly paid. I'll also have our system corrected so it reflects the successful status.
